risks.finding: Both PWAs cache HTML/manifest/icon but not their hashed JS/CSS. After clearing HTTP cache, closing Chrome, stopping both origins, and restarting Chrome, navigation returned cached HTML while Script and Stylesheet failed net::ERR_FAILED; both roots were empty.
The Stage cache-first handler uses global caches.match rather than the current named cache. A matching response in impromptu-stage-public-v0 replaced the live Stage document with STALE_CACHE_CANARY.
Chromium logs that frame-ancestors is ignored in a meta CSP, preview responses carry no CSP header, and a cross-origin evil.localhost page rendered the Stage in an iframe.
With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce active, .ui-reveal still computes to 0.52s; the intended 0.14s rule does not override the class animation.
The projected Stage document vertically overflows at 1440x900 (935px), 768x900 (916px), 320x800 (932px), and 200%-equivalent 720x450 (593px). The scrollbar remains visible in actual fullscreen.
